name: claudeignore-guard
description: Makes `.claudeignore` actually work. Claude Code has no native .claudeignore (anthropics/claude-code#579, #4160, #29455) yet blog posts teach it as if it did, so people list .env there and believe they are protected while nothing reads the file. This PreToolUse hook enforces it: Read/Edit/Write/NotebookEdit on a path matched by a .claudeignore is denied, and the denial names the exact file and line of the rule that blocked it. Full gitignore syntax — negation with !, anchoring, dir-only trailing /, ** — with nested .claudeignore files applied root-first so a deeper rule wins. Hand-rolled matching rather than `git check-ignore`, which would drag in the repo's .gitignore and block every build artifact too. Does NOT cover Bash or Grep/Glob (see docs); permissions.deny remains the real security boundary. Env: CLAUDEIGNORE_DISABLED=1, CLAUDEIGNORE_MODE=warn.
